items.title: MECH-449/ARC-107: envelope-width dose response for the perseveration No-Go -- where is the knee, and is the leg inert at the SHIPPED f_eligibility_envelope_floor of 0.30? (V3-EXQ-926a's stated finding of record, never characterised)
items.note: SUCCESSOR TO V3-EXQ-926a, WHICH NAMED THIS AND DECLINED TO DO IT. 926a's manifest notes state its own finding of record verbatim: 'at the stock f_eligibility_envelope_floor of 0.30 the identical mechanism converted 1/16, because the MECH-448 envelope collapses to the fail-open protect-min and the axis cannot fire. That INTERACTION (perseveration No-Go is structurally gated by envelope width) is the finding of record here, and it is not documented anywhere in the MECH-449 build notes or in V3-EXQ-689g.' That interaction rests on TWO points, only ONE of which was ever written to a manifest -- the 0.30 datapoint was authoring-time scratch recorded only in prose. This run puts both 926a anchors on one ladder under identical recorded conditions plus four intermediate doses (0.30/0.25/0.20/0.15/0.10/0.05). WHY IT MATTERS: f_eligibility_envelope_floor SHIPS at 0.30. If the perseveration leg cannot fire at the stock default, the built ARC-107 constitution has a leg that is inert as configured and every run leaving the knob alone measures an axis that cannot act -- a build-configuration fact the ARC-107 roadmap needs and lacks. The deliverable is the KNEE: the narrowest envelope at which the leg has authority. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = per-dose ARM_CONSTITUTION conversion_rate vs f_eligibility_envelope_floor. Checked all 17 manifests carrying config.f_eligibility_envelope_floor (485i/485j/485k, 654h/654i/654j, 689d/689e/689f/689i, 699/699b, 705/705b/706/706b, 926a). Corpus-wide only TWO floor values exist (0.10 in 926a alone; 0.30 in 15 runs that do not measure perseveration conversion), and only 926a carries the readout at all, at ONE dose. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): MECH-449 = 0, ARC-107 = 0, NOT braked. MECH-439 = 12 with ceiling_decision exhausted and is DELIBERATELY NOT TAGGED -- this poses no F-dominance lever and must not be read as a 13th probe of that lineage. MECH-260 NOT TAGGED for 926a's reason (falsifier is behavioural, vacuous at the MECH-457 competence floor). SUBSTRATE-PATH GATE (Step 2.5c): driver import closure is dacc.py + e2_fast.py + e3_selector.py + config.py; the one open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry (contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy -> e1_deep.py) does NOT overlap it. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): DV is committed argmin identity aggregated to a conversion rate; argmin's symmetry group is {uniform additive constant, monotone rescaling, tie permutation}. ARM_CONSTITUTION and ARM_SHUFFLED change set MEMBERSHIP (the argmin's DOMAIN), which is in none of that group -- NOT invariant. ARM_OFF runs at EVERY dose, not once: without it a dose-dependent rise is aliased between the No-Go acting and the widened envelope alone moving the baseline committed pick. That is an ADDITION to 926a, which ran ARM_OFF at a single floor. 926a's PER-CELL 'envelope >= 2' READINESS GATE IS DELIBERATELY NOT CARRIED OVER: here a collapsed envelope at the stock floor IS the phenomenon under study, so a whole-run all(...) gate over per-cell envelope size would fail on the stock dose and vacate the wide-envelope doses that ran cleanly -- the V3-EXQ-785 defect exactly. Replaced by P2 envelope_size_dose_separation (range-gated criterion -> range readiness, per the V3-EXQ-643 same-statistic rule); per-cell envelope size is still recorded on every cell as a non-gating diagnostic. P1 anchor reachability is PROVEN AT SETUP by _assert_p1_anchor_reachable(), which replays the shipped control through the shipped comparison (control worst range 0.7500 vs gate 0.25, margin 0.5000). PURPOSE=diagnostic: excluded from confidence/conflict scoring by design; characterises an operating curve rather than posing a new falsifier, and PROMOTES NOTHING. SMOKE PASS on the Mac (2 floors x 3 arms x 2 seeds x 4 banks): outcome=PASS, per-seed lift 0.5/0.5 vs a 0.40 pre-registered floor, env_sep 1.750 vs a 1.0 floor, knee=0.10, empty_eligible=0. DOSE-VARIATION ASSERTED (the flat-sweep guard): the DV genuinely moves across swept values rather than saturating. A full-size single cell at floor 0.10 measured conversion 0.9766, reproducing 926a's 0.969/0.969/1.0 anchor. validate_experiments.py --strict OK with 0 warnings of every class; 534 lint contracts pass with the script in the corpus. Full grid timed at ~34s on the Mac.
